items.title: Sweet Williams Interview
items.q: Red Caillou. Do you know him? I knew him first.

ctx.x: What's his other name? I don't know. He's only known as Drive-Em-Down. I don't remember that. I don't remember Drive-Em-Down. Oh, Red Caillou?

Red Caillou. Do you know him? I knew him first. He left there and went to Oakland. He died out in Oakland. When? Oh, in the parties. In the parties. He died in the parties. Early parties in Oakland, California.
And when did he leave? He left there. He left there behind me. He left New Orleans. I left New Orleans.
